security.csp: default-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: asset: http://asset.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: Low-resource live wallpaper engine for Wayland
bundle.longDescription: OWE renders static, animated, and video wallpapers on Wayland layer-shell surfaces with a resource governor, and integrates natively with Hyprland and Caelestia Shell. The window is a disposable control panel for the owed daemon.
